rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for work, efforts, or activities that produce good results.

example.english: Studying this way is really productive.
example.traditional: 你咁樣溫書真係好有成效。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 wan1 syu1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sing4 haau6

rows.note: Use this for comments, discussions, or suggestions that are constructive and help improve a situation rather than simply getting results.

example.english: Your suggestion is very productive; it helps us solve the problem.
example.traditional: 你個建議好有建設性，幫到我哋解決問題。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 gin3 ji5 hou2 jau5 gin3 cit3 sing3 bong1 dou2 ngo5 dei6 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for a person, writer, animal, or land that produces a large amount, including the prolific slice of sense 0.

example.english: This writer has always been productive.
example.jyutping: nei1 wai2 zok3 gaa1 jat1 hoeng3 do1 caan2

rows.note: Use this mainly in economic, industrial, or business contexts for something related to production.

example.traditional: 呢個行業嘅生產性好高。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 ge3 sang1 caan2 sing3 hou2 gou1
